financials_interim.notes: Dialog Finance PLC (CALF) is a licensed finance company (NBFI), a subsidiary of Dialog Axiata PLC (99.05% owner). This filing presents a SINGLE set of statements (Company only, no subsidiaries to consolidate), so basis is recorded as GROUP by this project's convention for single-entity filings. Period entered is the SIX MONTHS ENDED 30 JUNE 2026 (H1 2026) -- the filing's own primary/certified period (title page: 'Condensed Interim Financial Statements for the Six Months Ended 30 June 2026'); the filing also discloses a three-months-ended-30-June column but the six-month cumulative figures are used here as the official period. Mapped per this project's NBFI convention (matches CDB/LOFC precedent): revenue = 'Total operating income' (1,604,419 = Net interest income 923,749 + Fee & commission income 650,822 + Net trading loss (813) + Other operating income 30,661) -- this line already nets out Interest expense (340,156) via Net Interest Income, so cost_of_sales/gross_profit/finance_costs/finance_income are left blank to avoid double-counting the interest expense. operating_profit = 'Operating Profit before taxes on financial services' (361,345), the company's own subtotal. Per the AAF-precedent two-tier tax convention: 'Taxes on financial services' (115,253, the VAT-FS-equivalent levy) sits between operating_profit and profit_before_tax and is NOT captured in tax_expense (no schema field for it) -- profit_before_tax is set to the filing's own 'Profit before tax for the period' (246,092, i.e. AFTER the taxes-on-financial-services deduction), and tax_expense = 'Income tax expense' only (99,221). Ties exactly: 246,092 - 99,221 = 146,871 = disclosed 'Profit for the period'. depreciation_amortization = 57,751 (Depreciation and amortization line in the P&L). Balance sheet: current_assets/current_liabilities/inventory/trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank per NBFI convention -- liquidity-ordered SOFP, no current/non-current split, and 'Financial assets at amortised cost - loans and advances' (10,500,237) is the core lending book, not a trade receivable. short_term_borrowings = 'Financial liabilities at amortised cost - due to banks' (2,012,904); no debenture/subordinated-debt line disclosed so long_term_borrowings is left blank. 'Financial liabilities at amortised cost - due to customers' (7,648,952, deposit funding) is deliberately EXCLUDED from borrowings per project convention -- customer deposits, not debt. Lease liabilities (104,069) also excluded, consistent with prior NBFI entries this project. total_assets (13,705,012) = total_liabilities (10,795,253) + total_equity (2,909,759) exactly. shares_in_issue = 117,399,866 (Note 6, Twenty largest shareholders total) -- cross-checked against EPS: 146,871k / 117,399,866 = Rs.1.2513, ties to disclosed EPS Rs.1.25. Cash flow figures are the six-month cumulative (H1 2026 vs H1 2025), consistent comparative basis (unlike some NBFI filings this project has seen where the cash-flow comparative is a full year). capex = 'Acquisition of property plant and equipment and intangible assets' (158,772, single combined line, no separate PPE/intangible split in the cash flow statement). KEY DRIVER: turnaround was driven by Device Financing and payments-business fee income -- Fee and commission income rose 72% YoY to Rs.650.8m (H1 2026) from Rs.379.2m (H1 2025), the single largest contributor to the 66.9% rise in Total operating income (Rs.1,604.4m vs Rs.961.4m), per the company's own financial review on page 2 and the segmental note (MSME segment net fee & commission income 187,367 up from 137,573; Consumer segment 463,455 up from 241,635).
